title: Create a second dashboard
blurb: Set up separate views for sales, admin or each team member.

steps.title: Open the dashboard menu
steps.body: Click the dashboard selector at the top left. You'll see **My Dashboards** and **Shared With Me**.

steps.title: Create a new one
steps.body: Choose to create a new dashboard, give it a name like "Sales this month", and start with a blank page or a copy of an existing one.

steps.title: Add your widgets
steps.body: Click **Add Widget** to fill it with the numbers that matter for this view.
steps.tip: Don't see **Add Widget**? Click **Edit dashboard** first.

steps.title: Share or set as default
steps.body: Use the three-dot menu on the dashboard to share it with your team or make it the default one people see.
